name: Midwife

pf.license.need: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a midwife, a birth assistant or the practice may add a license, certificate or registration it holds; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
pf.license.who: the business says what it holds; the owner adds each person's own number on the secure page
pf.license.ask: each person's license or certificate number, if they hold one, in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration number, if it has one
pf.license.check: none: nothing is looked up; Rosie never says a license was checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: the business's own word only: if the owner says a job needs a license a person doesn't have, that person isn't offered for it
pf.license.video: a video consult or visit with someone the owner says is licensed where the client is during the visit
pf.license.away: home births and home visits only where the owner says the midwife's kind may attend them in that place (the state's form; the owner's word)
pf.license.lactation: breastfeeding help: a lactation consultant's certification, if the owner adds one
pf.license.vaccines: none: no shot or vaccine orders are taken through Rosie
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.renewals: none: Rosie keeps no renewal dates; the owner can note one by hand
pf.license.insurance: malpractice insurance, if the owner adds it: a note only, never checked
pf.license.claims: 'licensed' or 'certified' is shown only where the owner says so; never as checked

pf.services.shape: clinic, with one long package of care: a client is cared for by one lead midwife (with a backup midwife she has met) from early pregnancy to about 6 weeks after the birth; prenatal visits run as a set series by the weeks, booked one at a time at checkout; the birth itself has no set time: from about 37 weeks the client's midwife and a birth assistant are on call for her at any hour; postpartum and newborn visits start from the day of the birth
pf.services.examples: the example practice's own prices and lengths, not a standard

list.name: Meet the midwife (free consult)
list.where: at the birth center, or by video
list.note: questions, the practice's way of care, and whether a birth at the birth center or at home fits

list.name: Birth center care package
list.kind: one price for the whole package
list.where: prenatal visits and the birth at the birth center; the first postpartum visits at home
list.before: a $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed
list.after: the rest is paid at the visits, never charged on its own on a set day
list.note: covers the prenatal visits, being on call from 37 weeks, the birth with the midwife and a birth assistant, the newborn exams, the postpartum visits and the 6-week visit; a health plan is billed instead where the practice takes it

list.name: Home birth care package
list.kind: one price for the whole package
list.where: prenatal visits at the client's home or at the office; the birth at home; the postpartum visits at home
list.before: a $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed
list.after: the rest is on the bill after the birth (a link to pay), never charged on a set day by itself
list.note: adds a home visit at about 36 weeks to check the home and the birth supplies; only where the state's rules allow the midwife's kind to attend home births, and only inside the practice's travel area (a set drive time from the hospital)

list.name: Prenatal visit (in a package)
list.price: uses one visit of the package
list.length: first visit 90 min; then 30 to 45 min
list.where: at the birth center, or at home for home-birth clients
list.repeat: the next visit is booked at checkout, as the midwife sets

list.name: Postpartum and newborn visit (in a package)
list.price: uses one visit of the package
list.where: at home, in the first days and weeks after the birth; at the birth center at about 6 weeks
list.note: dates are set from the day of the birth

list.name: Well-person visit (yearly exam)
list.after: the plan is billed; any share at the front desk
list.note: nurse-midwives only, where the license covers it

list.name: Lactation visit
list.where: at the office or at home
list.before: paid in full when booking (self-pay); nothing for package clients in the first 6 weeks

list.name: Childbirth class series
list.note: seats in a set series; at least 3 couples to run (the practice's cutoff a week before)

pf.services.capacity: each midwife takes a set number of clients due in one month (the practice's own cap, example 4) so births don't overlap; every birth needs two people (the midwife and a birth assistant or a second midwife); one birth room at the birth center; prenatal visits are one midwife's time
pf.services.onCall: from about 37 weeks to the birth, the client's lead midwife is on call for her at any hour; the client uses the practice's on-call line (pf.safety) when labor starts, her water breaks, or anything worries her. Rosie gives the number and books nothing for it
pf.services.online: a consult or a short prenatal check-in by video; it counts as at the office
pf.services.nobodyHome: never for a visit: the client must be there; a visit where nobody answers gets a safety check first (the welfare switch)
pf.services.walkIns: no walk-ins; a client in labor or with a worry uses the on-call line at any hour

beforeTimes: a new client or a current one
which visit: the practice's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
where the visit is: at the birth center, or at home (home visits only inside the practice's area)
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the client will be in
afterTime: anything the practice should know to help, like needing an interpreter
the client's name and mobile (for texts)
securePage: how the person booking is related to the client, if someone else books
the plan's member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
the health history and the risk screen
the consents and the privacy notice
the care agreement (signed on the secure page)
who else may attend, with the client's signed OK
pf.questions.whoMayBook: the client, or a support person the client names on the secure page; a minor books her own care only where the owner's state form lets her consent alone, and until the form says so a parent or guardian books; a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
pf.questions.whoMayBring: the client, or a support person the client names with a signed OK on the secure page; the practice may ask for a support person at a first visit, or where the state's rules require one
pf.questions.neverAsked: symptoms, pregnancy weeks, tests, results or the birth plan are never asked or typed in the AI chat

stop.words: heavy bleeding, a seizure, a bad headache with blurred vision, trouble breathing, chest pain, a fall or a car crash, or a newborn who isn't breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can't book care for an emergency. Then call the practice's on-call line: (555) 010-0188.
stop.booking: no booking; any visit stays booked

stop.words: labor, your water breaking, or less baby movement
stop.say: Call the on-call midwife now: (555) 010-0188. If you can't reach her, or it's an emergency, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking; the on-call midwife answers at any hour, and Rosie books or moves nothing for it

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If you are in danger, call 911. Your midwife is told.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 988 again

stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

nurseLine.words: the practice's own list of signs for its on-call line (the example practice lists a fever in late pregnancy, and less movement)
nurseLine.say: Please call the on-call line now: (555) 010-0188. If it's an emergency, call 911.
nurseLine.booking: no booking by Rosie until the midwife has talked with the client

goOn.words: a worry with nothing on the lists above
goOn.where: matched to the practice's own visit: Rosie never judges how serious it is

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, risk screen, the consents and the care agreement
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due before the first visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: the practice keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every client who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the client may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay clients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day, or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A client's records from the last care provider
steps.when: asked for on the secure page; the practice gets them, office to office
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk; the first visit goes ahead without them

steps.name: The owner's OK for a new client
steps.when: before the first visit is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

pf.first_steps.prep: arrive 10 minutes early; bring the plan card, and the records you have from before; a support person comes only with the client's signed OK on the secure page; at home: a clear space for the midwife's supplies

pf.visit.checkIn: at the birth center: the check-in code at the front desk, and the desk checks the client is the one who booked; a video visit: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the client at the door
pf.visit.beforeWork: the midwife checks the blood pressure, weight and the changes since the last visit, before the exam
pf.visit.changes: the midwife decides any test or shot from the client's record; a test is added only with the client's yes, with any self-pay price first; more care is booked as its own visit only if the client asks
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the visit notes, results and records stay in the practice's own chart, never in Rosie or a text; the next visit is booked at checkout
pf.visit.away: at home: the midwife brings the birth supplies and a scale; a grown-up is there for the whole visit
pf.visit.childLeft: never: the adult who brought the newborn stays for the whole visit

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking for a visit the plan pays, and a free consult takes nothing; a care package takes its $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed, and the rest is paid at the visits (birth center) or on the bill after the birth (home birth), never charged on a set day by itself; a self-pay lactation visit or a class is paid in full when booking
pf.money.plans: the plans the practice takes (its own list); the front desk checks each plan by hand and records it; the share is an estimate, not a promise
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay client is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)
pf.money.vaccines: none: no vaccine fees are taken through Rosie
pf.money.fees: no missed-visit fee by default; the owner may set one for self-pay visits only, never for a public-plan client
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for clients whose plan or the state's rules bar one, or whom the owner marks fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: at the birth center: the rest is paid at the visit; at home: the bill comes after the birth; a plan's share is billed the practice's own way, and a balance after the plan pays is billed by the practice, not by Rosie's text
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; fee limits for plan clients: from the plan's and the state's rules
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies, as for every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes; no memberships are sold here
pf.money.payOverTime: none: no package is charged on set days by itself; the rest is paid at a visit or on a bill the client gets and pays

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the pregnancy, symptoms, tests, results, the birth or the midwife's name at the birth center (at a home visit the midwife's name stays, for the door check)
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff carry the client's initials, the time and a link; never the visit type or any health detail
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the client needs an interpreter, and the practice is told
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the client, or to the person the client names on the secure page; nothing about a newborn is texted to anyone but the parent or guardian
pf.messages.medical: a medical question is never answered, saved or passed on: 911 if it's an emergency, then the on-call line or the practice's portal

pf.staff.licenses: each midwife's and birth assistant's own license or certificate, per state, if the owner adds it (optional; never checked by Rosie)
pf.staff.skills: midwives: prenatal visits, the birth at the birth center or at home (where the state's rules allow), postpartum and newborn visits, and well-person visits (nurse-midwives); birth assistants: births and postpartum visits with a midwife; the lactation consultant: breastfeeding help; only people the owner clears go to homes
pf.staff.supervision: a midwife who isn't yet fully licensed works under the state's rules for supervision or a collaboration agreement (the owner's form sets it)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs a new client's first visit, and any visit a midwife flags
pf.staff.standIn: a midwife out: the backup midwife the client has met may take the visit, with the client's yes; nobody is moved without it
pf.staff.away: the home team is the people the owner clears for home visits, with a scale and the birth supplies

pf.rules.records: the practice keeps a client's chart as long as the state's rules require; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the chart
pf.rules.copies: a client's copy of the records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.showLicense: any license the owner adds is shown where the owner says so; Rosie shows nothing as checked
pf.rules.minors: who may consent for a minor, from the state's form (the owner's setting)
pf.rules.custody: a court order or custody limit the practice holds is kept on its record, and Rosie follows the record, not the caller's word alone
pf.rules.language: free language help where the rules require it
pf.rules.host: none: no school or group hosting
pf.rules.ads: no free-visit or price claims the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form
pf.rules.papers: the birth certificate and newborn screening papers are the practice's own job, filed in the state's time; Rosie doesn't file them or track their dates

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen; later, the desk may offer a new time (the practice decides; Rosie never changes the booking itself)
pf.edges.officeLate: when the practice runs late, a new time costs nothing
pf.edges.standIn: a midwife out: the backup midwife the client has met, with the client's yes, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then the practice keeps the visit (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay with a written estimate, or a free cancel
pf.edges.twoBookings: a client with visits open for two people: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.worse: a client worried before a visit: the 911 or on-call words if they match; Rosie never judges how serious it is, and the visit stays booked
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about medicine or care before a visit: never answered by Rosie; 911 if it's an emergency, then the on-call line or the portal
pf.edges.siblings: a second person added to a booking (a partner at a class) gets their own seat
pf.edges.newborn: a home visit that can't happen as booked: the soonest open window comes first, with no fee, and the on-call line is named in the text
pf.edges.urgent: no service is sent now through Rosie: a birth is on call (the on-call line in pf.safety), and a client with a worry gets the soonest visit
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

story.A: Sam Lee, a midwife, signs up two companies by text. Then Alex books a free meet-the-midwife consult at Lee Birth Center with Nadia, for Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am, and later signs the care agreement for the birth center care package. Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.
story.B: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex books the home birth care package with Lee Home Births: a deposit when the care agreement is signed, and Priya, a midwife, comes to Alex's home Thu Oct 22 for a prenatal visit, arriving 8 to 10am with a scale. notes:
Texts: sensitive work, so visit types and service names are generic words in every text (a visit, care); the business name and the time stay.
K8 build (Oct 27 2026, REDESIGN 2 frozen master, prof-new + ADDENDUM + Haiku notes D96/D97). From: pediatrician (refit R04, a clinic with home visits; its words re-pointed), base plug-in: the midwife sample (test-drive Oct 24, verified notes kept: birth needs an on-call window (gap 1), package money, care moved midway, nobody home at a postpartum visit, a missed package visit, the free consult, a pregnancy loss; the verified findings are in work/gaps/midwife.json).
D96: licenses are optional and never verified. pf.license says nothing is looked up; the license words on the lit sign-up and staff steps (S1-23, S1-32, S1-35, S1-60, S1-79, S2-06, S2-11, S2-13, S2-22, S2-29, S11-48, S11-50, S11-57, S11-99, S11-100, S13-11, S13-41, S13-43, S13-45) are the owner's word by rename pairs; S2-11's lookup branches are off; S2-29 stays lit with words. The master's own license-check steps are a master change (MASTER lines in the log).
D97: the $2 applies. S1-62's 'No $2' branch is off in both flows; no2 is never switched on; the sibling's no-$2 money line is dropped (pf.money.rosfield says the $2 applies).
Money A (the birth center): main list|deposit|counter (the birth center care package, example $4,500: a $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed, the rest paid at the visits, never on a set day by itself); list|none|none (the free meet-the-midwife consult); list|none|counter (a well-person visit, $180 self-pay, or billed to the plan with any share at the front desk); list|full|none (the childbirth class series, $200 per couple, paid in full when booking).
Money B (the home): main list|deposit|bill (the home birth care package, example $5,500: a $1,000 deposit when the care agreement is signed, the rest texted as a bill after the birth); list|none|own (a postpartum visit at home billed to the family's plan, the practice's own way); list|full|none (a self-pay lactation visit at home, $150, paid in full when booking).
The fee on the deposit paths is the $1,000 deposit kept if care stops by the agreement (fee never more than what was paid now). No missed-visit fee by default. No card-saved path, no holds, no installments (the package's installments are a gap).
Switches: sensitive (health: no rating, initials-only texts; A10-34 and B10-32 yes-rating branches off) and welfare (a client may be unable to answer after a birth: a safety check before any no-show words). no2: never on.
Facts: children, classes, documents, extrawork, firststeps, forms, groups, planbill, video. Not listed: plans (prenatal visits are booked one at a time at checkout, the next one at checkout), sentnow (S2-30 'Yes: sent now' off: births are on call through the practice's on-call line in pf.safety), stages, results, spaces, dropoff.
Classes run in flow A only (S1-82 'Yes' kept in A, off in B). Spaces and stays are off in A (a client books a person's time).
Pronouns: the staff are they/their in the pronoun pairs (Priya, Nadia), Sam is he; the client is Alex (no pronoun).
Names: Sam Lee owns Lee Birth Center LLC (flow A: the birth center, 31 Birch Lane) and Lee Home Births LLC (flow B: home birth care and postpartum visits, 305 Cedar Ave). Alex M. is the client. Staff: Nadia (midwife) and Greta (birth assistant) at the birth center; Priya (midwife) and Ruth (birth assistant) at home. Master words replaced: Riley, Avery, Jordan, Casey, Lena, Hugo, Tomas; plumbing, electrical and barbershop words; the example prices; the plumbing jobs (water heater, drain clearing) became home birth and postpartum examples.
Splits decided: S1-60 and S2-28 kept (both license branches; no lookup); S1-82 classes kept in A; S1-80 spaces off; S1-62 $2 'No' off; S2-30 'Yes sent now' off; A4-66, A8-53, A8-67, A10-05, A10-44, A10-45, A4-43, A4-80 off (A); B8-03, B4-16, B6-03, B7-55, B8-58, B8-67, B4-83 (set start, stay, seat), B4-43, B9-19, B9-06, B10-37, B10-38, B4-92, B8-68 off (B).
Not sure (for the verifier): (1) the rest of a package is paid at the visits (A) or on the bill after the birth (B), not in installments by 36 weeks: the schedule is a gap, the paths list only what the record can say; (2) the $1,000 fee on deposit paths is the deposit as kept by the agreement; (3) the on-call line (555) 010-0188 is an example number; labor, water breaking and less movement give the line now (pf.safety), but nothing rings the on-call midwife (gap 1); (4) S11-99 / S13-41 / S13-43 license-recheck wording was replaced by pairs and still reads as a master rule in places; (5) the A4-34 several-services example (a lactation visit with a well-person visit) reads as an example only.
MASTER: (1) D96 is not in the frozen master: S1-23, S1-32, S1-35, S1-79, S2-06, S2-22, S11-48, S11-50, S11-57, S11-99, S11-100, S13-11, S13-41, S13-43, S13-45 still say a license lookup checks it; the main session's D96 switch (verification step OFF) would clear these on every profession. (2) S1-62's 'Safe default' and 'Human health practices and law firms pay no $2' still read in the master (overlay words replace them here); D97 wants that text changed in the master. (3) S2-29 gives license_checked only through its lookup text; S2-15 and S2-22 need that key on the no-license path. (4) S12-19 'The state's license lookup is down' is a master step with no lookup (off here).
